caption: The drawing displays three views of a brass or gold-colored metal furniture fitting, likely a decorative drawer handle and escutcheon. At the top, there is a frontal view of the escutcheon with a symmetrical and scalloped outline featuring a central keyhole and two smaller, keyhole-like decorative cutouts flanking it. Below, there is a matching frontal view of the same escutcheon, but with a horizontally curved handle attached by two round knobs or hinges; the handle arches downward in a U-shape. To the right, a side view shows the thickness of the fitting and the protrusion of the knobs and the handle's curve. The objects are placed on a light tan background with a thin rectangular border enclosing the composition, and a small linear scale for measurement is present in the bottom left corner. The drawing is rendered in shades of gold and brown to suggest the metallic sheen and dimensionality of the objects. The artist's name "P. Johnson" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Drawer Pull
